description: This file defines the AuthCodeRepository class implementing OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface, with methods for handling OAuth2 authorization codes, including creating, revoking, and checking revocation status.

classes.name: AuthCodeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface for managing OAuth2 authorization codes within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended to persist a new auth code.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; intended to revoke an auth code.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the auth code is revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity.
